theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_canon_nt_open_cover_finite_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (U : Set (Euclidean N)), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → ∃ W : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N), (∀ i, IsOpen (W i) ∧ W i ⊆ U ∧ μ (W i) ≠ ∞) ∧ U ⊆ ⋃ i, W i
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
